summary: A candidate turns down an offer politely and says the other role fits their goals better.
realLife: Career guidance says to decline in writing, thank the employer and not say you got a better job; say the other role fits your goals at this stage. Backing out after accepting costs employers time and the candidate's reputation.
sources: UW-Madison SuccessWorks, accepting and negotiating your offer: https://successworks.wisc.edu/accepting-and-negotiating-your-offer/
inGame: Declining is a choice on the offer call; reputation carries on the person's ties to those at the employer. Needs: an offer record.
